prompt: Change the page title and heading to HELLO WORLD and update the primary button to purple.

tasks.title: Set the page title and heading to HELLO WORLD
tasks.instructions: In src/pages/index.html change two things to "HELLO WORLD": the document title (the <title> element) and the main heading (<h1 id="title">). Change no other text.
acceptanceCriteria: The <h1 id="title"> heading reads exactly "HELLO WORLD".

tasks.title: Update primary button to purple
tasks.instructions: Locate the primary button styling and change its color to purple. Leave other button variants unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Secondary and other button variants are unaffected.

prompt: Rename the --brand CSS variable to --accent in the theme.

tasks.title: Rename --brand to --accent
tasks.instructions: In src/styles/theme.css rename the custom property --brand to --accent: its declaration and every var(--brand) use. Keep its value and every other property unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: --accent has the old value and both uses read var(--accent).

prompt: Fix the paging bug in paginate().

tasks.title: Fix paginate()
tasks.instructions: src/lib/paginate.js takes a 1-based page number but treats it as 0-based, and its page count drops a last partial page. Fix both so page 1 is the first page and `pages` counts a partial last page (0 pages for no items). Keep the signature and return shape { items, page, pages }.
acceptanceCriteria: The page count includes a last partial page and is 0 for an empty list.

tasks.title: Add slugify()
tasks.instructions: Create src/feature/slugify.js exporting slugify(text): lowercase, strip accents (Unicode NFD, drop combining marks), replace every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single hyphen, and trim leading and trailing hyphens. Text with no letters or digits gives an empty string.
acceptanceCriteria: Accents are stripped, separators collapse, and edge hyphens are trimmed.
Input with no letters or digits gives ''.

tasks.title: Add parseDuration()
tasks.instructions: Create src/lib/duration.js exporting parseDuration(text) that turns strings like '45s', '2m', '1h30m' or '1d2h3m4s' into a number of seconds. Units are d, h, m, s, each at most once and in that order; amounts are non-negative integers. Throw a TypeError for a non-string and a RangeError for anything else that does not match exactly (empty, no unit, unknown unit, repeated or out-of-order units, decimals, signs, whitespace).
acceptanceCriteria: Valid strings return the total seconds.
Malformed strings throw RangeError; non-strings throw TypeError.

prompt: Add a per-key token-bucket rate limiter.

tasks.title: Add a token-bucket rate limiter
tasks.instructions: Create src/lib/rate-limiter.js exporting createRateLimiter({ capacity, refillPerSecond, now = Date.now }). Each key has its own bucket that starts full and refills continuously at refillPerSecond tokens per second, never above capacity. tryTake(key, cost = 1) takes `cost` tokens and returns true, or returns false and takes nothing. retryAfterMs(key, cost = 1) returns 0 if `cost` tokens are available now, else the milliseconds until they will be (rounded up). A cost above capacity throws RangeError; capacity or refillPerSecond that is not a positive number throws RangeError. Read time only through `now()`.
acceptanceCriteria: Bursts up to capacity are allowed, then refused.
Refill is continuous and capped at capacity; keys are independent.
retryAfterMs is exact for an injected clock; invalid options and costs throw RangeError.
